text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
...We still have some time before departure.
I think I can squeeze in three more runs.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Ai-san... ain't here.
Most likely, she's still putting in laps.

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
The bus is about to leave!
I'll go call her!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: ......Pushed to the absolute brink, like this...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
That's why... she is Almond Eye, shining
so brilliantly in the annals of history...

"A shining legend in history—Chrono Genesis seems
to view Almond Eye as an existence fundamentally different from herself..."

"You could say that... a subconscious belief that
they are an unbeatable opponent is at work."

I need to reshape Chrono Genesis's mindset,
and find a way for us to beat Almond Eye—
Returning from the training camp, I immediately gather materials. The full details of every 'Genesis Method' received from Chrono Genesis so far, along with—

Various training methods.
I'll cross-reference these to formulate a plan.

I will definitely lead Chrono Genesis to victory
at the Tenno Sho (Autumn)—!
